Vanguard.title: The Vanguard
Vanguard.loreInfo: The elite frontline shock troops of the dungeon, clad in thick, rusted iron.

Sun-King.title: The Sun-King
Sun-King.loreInfo: The tyrannical ruler of the surface realm. His light burns the eyes of the deep dwellers.

The Deep Flame.title: The Deep Flame
The Deep Flame.loreInfo: A primordial, sentient entity of fire that slumbers at the planet's core.

Order of the Light.title: Order of the Light
Order of the Light.loreInfo: Fanatical surface zealots sworn to eradicate all dungeon ecology.

fear.title: Dread
fear.text: The terrifying presence you project. Too low, mutiny. Too high, paralysis.

horde.title: The Swarm
horde.text: The endless tide of lowly goblins. Keep them fed and breeding.

might.title: The Bruisers
might.text: Your heavy hitters—Uruks, trolls, and beasts. Keep them bashing.

loot.title: The Stash
loot.text: Shiny rocks, stolen armor, and moldy cheese. Keep it hoarded.

fear_low.title: The Laughing Stock
fear_low.description: The ranks no longer fear your shadow. They've turned your throne into a communal latrine and are currently using your crown to play 'toss the turnip.' You have been evicted.

fear_high.title: The Silent Tomb
fear_high.description: Your reign of terror was too successful. The goblins are so paralyzed by fear they've stopped eating, breathing, and moving. You rule a dungeon of petrified statues.

horde_low.title: The Lonely Overlord
horde_low.description: The last goblin has packed his bindle and left. The dungeon is empty, the torches have flickered out, and you're left arguing with the echoes.

horde_high.title: The Green Tide Rises
horde_high.description: Overpopulation has reached critical mass. The goblins have eaten the supplies, then the furniture, then... well, you always were the 'Big Meat.'

might_low.title: Paper Walls
might_low.description: A single surface-dweller toddler wandered in and accidentally tripped over your entire defense line. The Vanguard has dissolved into tears. You surrender to a five-year-old.

might_high.title: Military Coup
might_high.description: The Vanguard realized that if they can kill a Dragon, they can certainly kill a Boss who spends all day sitting on a throne. You are violently retired.

loot_low.title: Complete Bankruptcy
loot_low.description: You tried to pay the Uruks in 'exposure' and 'good vibes.' They preferred to pay themselves with your internal organs.

loot_high.title: The Wyrm's Visit
loot_high.description: Your hoard grew so bright it acted as a beacon for an Ancient Red Wyrm. It didn't even fight you; it just sat on the dungeon until everything flatlined.

char_1.name: Kargoth the Ironclad
char_1.flavor: A towering wall of muscle and rust. He speaks in grunts and violence.

char_2.name: Snivel the Goblin
char_2.flavor: A wretched creature from the deep warrens.

char_3.name: Uruk Warlord
char_3.flavor: A hulking brute demanding tribute or blood.

char_4.name: Greenfang Bruiser
char_4.flavor: Commander of the green tide. Thinks with his fists.

char_5.name: Blood Scarred Orc
char_5.flavor: A hardened veteran of a hundred surface raids.

char_6.name: The Shadow Priest
char_6.flavor: Chanter of the dark litanies and keeper of secrets.

char_7.name: Fallen Knight
char_7.flavor: An oathbreaker who found a new master in the dark.

char_8.name: Dungeon Merchant
char_8.flavor: A greedy peddler of cursed surface goods.

char_9.name: The Abyssal Warden
char_9.flavor: An ancient evil stirred from its long slumber.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth found a stash of rusted halberds. Arm his brutes, or melt them for scrap?

dialogues.text: Tetanus is a feature, not a bug.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth demands the goblins serve his unit double rations. *The small ones are starving.*
Kargoth challenges you to a test of strength. Refuse, or risk your pride in the pit?
Kargoth threw a goblin scout into the forge for "talking back." Punish him?
Kargoth wants to use the elf prisoners as throwing weapons. *"Aerodynamics good,"* he grunts.
Kargoth drank the forge-coolant again. He is glowing and wants to hug a wizard.

dialogues.text: He is currently melting the floorboards with his feet.

nextCard.cardText: Kargoth bear-hugged the Grand Pyromancer. The resulting explosion destroyed the west wing but successfully vaporized the wizard.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth found a "pet" bear. It has already eaten three goblins. Can he keep it?

dialogues.text: It only eats what bleeds. So, no.

nextCard.cardText: The bear broke loose, ate the master armor smith, and escaped into the lower tunnels. We are now down a smith and up a bear problem.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth insists on painting his armor red because "red goes fasta." Do we fund this?
Kargoth is trying to invent "Orc Yoga." The cracking noises are echoing through the whole cave.
Kargoth accidentally swallowed the armory key. He says he feels "secure."
Master! We found a **shiny rock**, but it burns to touch!
We brewed a new mushroom stew! *It glows in the dark!*
The shiny rocks in the vault... we ate some. Now our tummies hurt *real bad*.
Master, we built a **catapult!** It shoots other goblins! Can we test it?

dialogues.text: Gribble said he wanted to see the sun.

nextCard.cardText: Gribble hit the ceiling, bounced off a stalactite, and landed directly in the gold vault, crushing our favorite treasure chest.

DECK_JSON.prompt: We found a door with a **big skull** on it! Should we knock?
Master! The rat-catchers formed a guild! They demand extra mold on their bread!
We found a glowing orb. It keeps screaming prophecies about a "Hero" in green. Smash it?
Master! I found a **Magic Window**! When I look in, another handsome goblin looks back!

dialogues.text: I pinched it from the shiny elf-man's bag!

nextCard.cardText: Snivel smashed the mirror. A rogue shard of glass bounced up and severed the Chief Treasurer's ear.

DECK_JSON.prompt: We found a pile of surface-dweller "Health Insurance" forms. Can we eat them?
Master, we built a monument to you out of mud and old bones! It smells awful!
Some of the boys started a union. They want "Safety Railings" over the lava pits.
We found a shiny golden cup! We have been using it to scoop out the latrines.
Master! A human adventurer dropped a "Cookbook". Now the cooks refuse to serve anything raw!
The men of the West are marching on our upper gates.
My Uruks demand a larger share of the plunder to stay in line. Pay up.
I want to challenge the **Greenfang Bruiser** to a duel for supremacy of the [[Vanguard]].
We captured a dwarven engineer. I want to torture him. The goblins want him to build traps.
My troops complain the torture chambers lack "ambiance". I told them I'd impale them atmospherically. Approve?
The dwarven king sent a formal scroll demanding we stop chanting at midnight. I intend to eat the messenger.

dialogues.text: It was heavily perfumed and asked politely. Disgusting.

nextCard.cardText: The dwarven messenger was wearing concealed spiked armor. The Warlord is now in the infirmary with a perforated colon.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The [[Vanguard]] is complaining about "Work-Life Balance". They want Tuesdays off to pillage for *fun*.
Our scouts captured an elven bard. He won't stop playing the lute. It is demoralizing the troops.
I demand better siege engines. We cannot conquer the surface with sharpened logs.
My lieutenant challenged me for command. I can crush him, but he is a skilled fighter.
Da boyz want better meat. *Rat meat ain't cuttin' it no more.*
Puny humans built a wooden fort near our cave. ==Let me smash it!==
Dis armor is too tight. I want new plates made of **pure gold!**
Da boyz are bored. Can we have a *fight pit*? Winner gets extra grog!
Da boyz wanna start a 'Choir'. It's just two hours of us screaming at a rock.
I punched a wall and found a hidden room full of cursed dwarven ledgers. Should we burn 'em?
Da boyz caught a troll. It says it wants to be an accountant. Should we smash it?

dialogues.text: It counted to three before biting off its own finger.

nextCard.cardText: The troll ate the financial ledger and then declared bankruptcy. At least his size intimidated the surface tax collectors.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I challenged a stalagmite to a headbutting contest. I lost. Da boyz are laughing at me.
We looted a carriage full of fancy silk hats. Can we wear them into battle?
I want to grease the entrance ramp. Any hero running in will slide right into a wall.
I caught a surface thief sneaking into the lower vaults. Flay him?
I remember the layout of the [[Sun-King]]'s armory. Give me 100 men and I'll bring back **steel**.

dialogues.text: Soft as butter. But they have shiny spears.

nextCard.cardText: The raid was successful, but the Sun-King's guards fought fiercely. The veteran returns with carts of steel, missing half his jaw.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My old wounds ache. The winter is cold. I need the ***Shadow Priest***'s dark magic to fight.
Found some surface *grog*. It makes the boyz fight harder... and die faster.
I've survived eighty raids, but the new recruits keep polishing their armor instead of sharpening their axes. Can I flay them?
An elf shot me in the kidney with a glowing arrow. I kept it as a torch. Can I have a sick day?
The new recruits don't even know how to properly sever a limb! They need live practice.
Back in my day, we didn't have "healing potions." We rubbed dirt in our wounds! Ban the potions.
I found an orphaned human baby during the raid. It looked at me... and didn't cry.
My axe is rusted dull, but it holds the blood of a hundred kings. The smith wants to melt it.
The dark altar requires a sacrifice of **royal blood** to awaken the old ones.
The stars align in a bloody crescent. We must sacrifice the *plumpest goblins* ==tonight==.
I can bind the screaming souls of fallen heroes to our [[Vanguard]]'s armor. It requires a tithe of **gold**.
The whispers from the deep abyss are getting louder. *Should I answer them?*
The Abyss demands a virgin sacrifice, but there's a blizzard outside. Can we just use a particularly pure goblin?
I accidentally summoned a lesser demon of misplaced items. Now all the armory keys are missing.

nextCard.cardText: Smashing the doors triggered the arcane wards. The armory is open, but half the Vanguard is permanently singed and terrified.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The [[The Deep Flame]] is hungry, but the sacrificial pits are closed for a **Mandatory Safety Inspection**.
I have started a "Book Club" reading the Necronomicon. The goblins are taking it surprisingly well.
Tentacles are coming out of the plumbing again. The plumbers require hazard pay.
The dark gods demand a "Void Tax." 20% of all shiny rocks must be thrown into the abyss.
My chanting is causing the stalactites to fall and crush the workers. Should I hum instead?
My former brothers-in-arms seek to redeem me. Let me crush them to prove my loyalty.
A ***paladin*** of the [[Order of the Light]] approaches the dungeon alone. I request the honor of a duel.
My rusted armor reminds me of my failure to the light. Forge me a new suit of **dark steel**.
The goblins lack discipline. They are pathetic. Let me train them... *brutally*.
My spiked armor of eternal suffering is chafing terribly. May I line it with velvet?
The Paladins sent me a bouquet of holy warding-garlic to "cure" me. It smells... delicious. What do I do?
A squire from the [[Order of the Light]] is weeping in the dungeons. He looks like my son... let him go?

dialogues.text: His resolve is weak, but his heart is still stubbornly pure.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Goblins mock my vows of dark chivalry. They do not understand the etiquette of a proper duel.
I wish to mount an expedition to retrieve my old horse's skeleton and reanimate it as my steed.
My old holy sword burns my hand, but it is a mastercrafted weapon. Melt it into spikes?
I have a rare, **cursed artifact** from the surface. Yours for a bag of gold.
Got a fresh shipment of healing potions. They are slightly expired, *but cheap!*
I found a map to a hidden vein of **dark iron**. I need funding to start the mining operation.
The **Shadow Priest** owes me coin for incense. Collect it for me, and I'll cut you in.
I am selling naming rights to the new slime pits. Interested in the "Overlord's Vats of Agony" package?
I've devised a multi-tiered scheme involving cursed wishing coins. Want in on the ground floor?
Business is slow. Let's install a **Gift Shop** at the end of the Hall of Screams. Tourists love keychains.
I'm introducing "Non-Fungible Trinkets." It's just regular rocks, but I tell the Uruks they are rare.

dialogues.text: Uruks aren't known for their financial literacy. Yes.

nextCard.cardText: The Uruks quickly realized the rocks are everywhere. They are now throwing the "currency" at the Merchant's head.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Inflation has hit the dungeon. A single rat skewer now costs 40 gold pieces. Do we fix prices?
I want to sell "Mystery Loot Boxes" to the Vanguard. It's mostly just rusty spoons.
A noble from the surface wants to buy a timeshare in our torture chambers for his "vacations."
The seals holding back the arcane horrors are weakening, **Overlord**.
THE DEEP WATER... IT HUNGERS FOR THE **SHINY METAL**. ==FEED IT.==
THE LITTLE GREEN ONES MULTIPLY TOO FAST. THEY MAKE GOOD KINDLING FOR [[The Deep Flame]].
A RIFT IN REALITY OPENS IN THE CATACOMBS. *PEER INSIDE?*

dialogues.text: I SEE A DIMENSION OF INFINITE SPREADSHEETS AND CUBICLES. TRULY TERRIFYING.

nextCard.cardText: Three goblins looked into the rift and instantly formed an HR department. Bureaucracy is spreading and morale has plummeted.

DECK_JSON.prompt: THE MORTALS HAVE INVENTED "PAPER MONEY". IT LACKS THE TASTE OF SOULS. SHALL WE BURN THEIR BANKS?
MY TENTACLES ARE TANGLED IN THE LEY-LINES. THE WARLOCKS ARE RIOTING OVER THE MAGICAL INTERFERENCE.
==THE VOICES== TELL ME YOU ARE JUST A REFLECTION IN A CRYSTAL SLAB HELD BY A GIANT. BREAK THE SLAB?
REALITY IS THINNING IN THE LOWER DEPTHS. GEOMETRY NO LONGER MAKES SENSE. CHARGE ADMISSION?
I HAVE ADOPTED A MORTAL KITTEN. IF ANYONE HARMS IT, I WILL UNMAKE THE CONCEPT OF TIME.
THE STARS ARE WRONG TODAY. I WISH TO SLEEP FOR A THOUSAND YEARS. DO NOT WAKE ME.
AN EXISTENTIAL DREAD HAS GRIPPED THE HORDE. THEY REALIZE THEIR LIVES ARE JUST NUMBERS ON A BAR.
